producer: Reverified retained Pet PE evidence and current owned UI source binding; not new REA provider execution
own_policy: Stable config shadow per invocation; native fresh reads are modeled separately in the core API.
Settings must finish cleanup before the owned worker starts; this is not source thread scheduling proof.
Explicit increasing capture ticket; pending helper return resumes without replay of accepted stores.
Owned timer stores persist between captures and setting changes; profile document replacement clears them and rejects old tickets.
Same values in a different profile document still invalidate old worker captures.
limitations: Tk/synthetic examples are not VCL/getter/RTL/native execution.
No automatic game Pet observations, dispatcher attachment or summon/mode/feed transport is bound.
No independent server or game acknowledgment; source exceptional/concurrent paths remain unverified.
